newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Ten die in Argentine army helicopter crash.
newsitem.headline: Ten die in Argentine army helicopter crash.

text.p: An Argentine army helicopter crashed in a Buenos Aires polo ground on Tuesday, killing 10 people including Argentine and Peruvian generals and their wives, the army said.
The French Puma helicopter crashed at 1735 local time (2035 GMT) while returning with a visiting Peruvian army delegation from a pleasure trip to the River Plate delta.

The army said the dead included Peruvian Gen. Hugo Soto Nunez, Argentine Gen. Juan Carlos Andreoli, and their wives. Another senior Peruvian officer and his wife died, along with four other Argentines.
Another five military personnel were injured, including the helicopter's three crew members.
Argentine media reported that the pilot tried to make an emergency landing at the polo ground, managing to avoid a busy highway by only 40 yards (metres).

Television images showed fire fighters battling flames engulfing a mass of unrecognizable wreckage on the green grass of the Argentine Polo Grounds in the suburb of Palermo. The aircraft's twisted tail lay nearby.

A civilian eyewitness told local television how an injured man ran enveloped in flames from the wreckage: "They shouted 'Get out! Get out! Get out!' And they were waiting for him with a fire extinguisher, and they put him out."
He said the helicopter had been coming in to land when it flipped over and crashed.
An army spokesman told Reuters the cause of the crash was still not known.
